title: Cover A — stacked statement
desc: Large statement high on the page, supporting line bottom left, stone cluster bottom right. The thread starts at the first node.

title: Cover B — document object
desc: A greeked page with one highlighted paragraph sits top right on a stone slab; the statement takes the lower half.

title: Cover C — oversized numeral
desc: One large clay numeral states the count; three stones echo it. Use for “N habits / N checks” openers.

title: Statement
desc: Kicker, one statement, one muted supporting line. A small stone pair anchors the top right.

title: Statement with check rows
desc: Statement plus up to four check rows (clay circle, paper tick) and an optional closing line.

title: Statement with pills
desc: Statement, supporting line and a row of pills (ink, accent or outline).

title: Comparison — this, not that
desc: Two stacked cards joined by a clay link line with a node (no arrowhead). The “not” card is quiet; the “this” card is raised.

title: Numbered step
desc: Step badge, a step track (01 02 03) with the current step on the thread, statement and supporting line.

title: Definition — what this does not settle
desc: A term and its plain definition, then a short list of what it does not settle, marked with thread dashes.

title: Checklist summary
desc: Numbered summary of the whole carousel. Rows carry tabular numerals; a note closes it.

title: Closing / CTA
desc: Closing statement, one line, a button and a note. The thread ends at the last node.

title: Statement with document
desc: Statement on top; a band of greeked pages below shows the idea (one highlighted paragraph). Pages are images: no text touches them.

title: Advocate series — cover
desc: Weekly series on past advocates. An empty labelled portrait frame (hatch-sand stone treatment) until a licensed image is supplied. No likeness ships in the template.

title: Advocate series — profile
desc: Portrait slot, name and era, a “what they did” block of up to three rows, and a sources line.

title: LinkedIn document — cover (PDF page 1)
desc: Reads as a proper first page in a PDF viewer: title, subtitle, contents, byline with mark and edition line.

title: LinkedIn document — closing
desc: Final PDF page: summary statement, one line, a button-styled action and a note. Stones close the document.

title: Hook
desc: Kicker fades up (0.1 s). Statement rises word by word (0.35 s, 0.09 s stagger). Case files settle up from below (1.0–1.8 s). Supporting line fades up (1.7 s).

title: Kicker, title, supporting line
desc: Kicker (0.1 s), statement word by word (0.3 s), a short thread draws under it (1.1–1.6 s), supporting line (1.4 s).

title: Document highlight
desc: Statement fades up (0.1 s). The page slides up (0.4–1.1 s). The highlight sweeps line by line across one paragraph (1.3–2.7 s); a clay margin mark grows beside it (2.6–3.0 s).

title: Strike-out list
desc: Title fades up. Items appear (0.5 s, 0.15 s stagger). A clay strike draws through each struck item in turn (1.3, 1.8, 2.3 s) and it dims. The kept item gains a thread dot and turns full strength (2.9 s).

title: Two-card comparison with link line
desc: Title fades up. The first card rises (0.5 s). A clay link line draws down between the cards with a node at each end, no arrowhead (1.2–1.8 s). The second card rises (1.7 s).

title: Check rows, one by one
desc: Title fades up. Each row rises 0.55 s after the last (from 1.0 s); its tick circle scales in 0.15 s after the row.

title: Numbered step
desc: Badge scales in (0.1 s). Step track fades up; the current step’s thread underline draws (0.6–1.0 s). Calendar settles in (0.8 s). Kicker, statement and supporting line follow (1.0, 1.15, 1.6 s).

title: Big number / keyword
desc: The number counts up from zero in whole steps (0.3–1.3 s, eased). Unit fades in beside it (1.1 s). Supporting line (1.5 s). For a keyword, set number to text: it rises instead of counting.

title: Principle card
desc: The court facade rises into place (0.2–1.2 s). Principle number fades up (0.9 s); statement rises word by word (1.05 s); supporting line (2.0 s). No quotation marks: a principle, not a quote.

title: End card
desc: Mark scales in on its paper disc (0.1 s); wordmark fades (0.4 s); closing line rises word by word (0.6 s); button rises (1.5 s); note fades (1.9 s). The progress thread reaches its last node.

title: Clay wipe
desc: A clay panel sweeps in from the left, covers the frame at the midpoint, and leaves to the right.

title: Paper fold
desc: Two paper leaves fold in from top and bottom on a centre crease, meet at the midpoint, and fold away.

title: Stone-block slide
desc: Three stone slabs (sand, clay, char) slide up in a stagger, overlap to cover at the midpoint, and lift away.

title: Thread draw
desc: A clay thread draws across the middle with a travelling node, thickens until it fills the frame at the midpoint, then thins away.

title: Ink iris from the node
desc: Warm ink spreads from the progress thread’s first node to fill the frame, then recedes into the last node.

title: Ink-to-paper flip
desc: An ink leaf turns in from the right edge; at the midpoint it is face-on, then its paper side turns away to the left.

title: Caption — ink-band
desc: Warm-ink bar, paper words; the spoken word sits on a dark-clay chip.

title: Caption — paper-slip
desc: Surface slip with a soft shadow; ink words; a thread underline marks the spoken word.

title: Caption — edge-word
desc: Rounded ink band; unspoken words a touch dimmer, the spoken word in edge clay.

title: Caption — stack
desc: Two large words at a time on a surface card (72 px); the spoken word in dark clay.

title: Caption — highlighter
desc: Surface card; the spoken word gets a clay highlighter sweep behind ink text.

title: Connection motifs — threads, link lines with dots, connector paths. No arrowheads.
